shots.purpose: Meet the ball and the first monster
shots.action: The red felt monster rolls a white yarn ball into a spotlight on a black lacquer floor
Each monster pushes the ball around one link; the paid-out thread draws the OpenAI blossom
The last thread is laid, the ball vanishes, a wave inflates the thread into plush tubes
Monsters run to the front; the logo swings upright behind them and they cheer
The room goes black; only the monsters' eyes glow
shots.holdReason: Darkness beat before the light run

shots.action: A light of each monster's colour runs its link, then spreads along all the yarn until they sum to white
Monsters gather in front of the white logo, squat, and jump
Flash; the frozen instant settles into a polaroid captioned OpenAI
